description: This file defines the RefreshToken class, representing a refresh token grant in the OAuth2 client library. It extends AbstractGrant and provides methods to retrieve the grant name and required request parameters.

classes.name: RefreshToken
classes.description: Represents a refresh token grant, extending AbstractGrant, used to refresh OAuth2 access tokens.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the string 'refresh_token', identifying the grant type.

methods.name: getRequiredRequestParameters
methods.description: Returns an array containing 'refresh_token' as the required request parameter.
